items.original: Accept the Claim Terms and Check Your Allocation

Accept the CT Claim Terms to see your allocation and the claim deadline. The interface blocks restricted jurisdictions by IP, and using a VPN to get around this breaks the terms and can get your claim blocked.

ACI announced a Creator Program on May 28, 2026, with a 400 USDT reward pool for content creators. If you post about the project, follow ACI on X and submit your entry to compete for a share. This step is optional and does not affect your testnet allocation.

ACI has confirmed a token airdrop, with 30,000,000 $ACI set aside for the current testnet phase. Participation is free. The only thing you need is Sepolia test ETH, which you claim from a faucet at no cost, and rewards come from completing on-chain activity and quests rather than buying anything.
Activate the in-app wallet
Add CT to Your Wallet
Add ETH for Gas
Add ETH on Base for Gas

Add liquidity to a Synthra pool on Arc. This covers 80% of the daily points pool: Set a price range around the current price so the position stays active New net liquidity earns extra points for its first 7 days while in range Rebalance if the price leaves your range, since out-of-range positions stop qualifying as active liquidity
Add your name and country for a small bonus, then connect X to appear on the referral leaderboard.
Airdropped CZR stays locked for 10 days after the October 1 launch. Until October 11, you cannot sell, trade, transfer or withdraw it.
All 10,000 NFTs were minted on September 16, so Wave 5 never opened, and the reveal is scheduled for October 14.

Ammora has no token and has not announced an airdrop, so this is a speculative play on a points program that may or may not convert into a distribution. What the team has committed to is beta access: the leaderboard guarantees seats to the top 1,000 point holders, plus 100 more drawn at random from everyone else.
Apply to Entropy Partners

BaiBai has not announced a token or airdrop, so this is a speculative opportunity. The team launched a points program alongside the public release, rewarding traders based on volume and activity. Early users get the biggest boost, and there is no official word yet on how points might convert to tokens.
Be active on the app on consecutive days. The 3-day and 5-day streaks pay 150 points each, and a full 7-day streak pays 300. All three reset weekly.

Beldex runs a Loyalty Program that awards Beldex Points for social and community tasks and ranks participants on a public leaderboard. The program page states that point holders become eligible for an airdrop and other incentives, but the points-to-BDX conversion rate, the reward pool size, and the snapshot date have not been announced.

Blackboard has not confirmed a token or an airdrop. What exists is Board Point, a rewards balance tied to trading activity, plus a live leaderboard and a referral program paying 10% of the Blackboard fee on invited users’ trades. Earning rates are still being finalized.
Build Weekly Activity Streaks
Cambria has extended the deadline for historical users to accept the Genesis Event Opt-In Agreement to October 8, 2026. Eligible users who don’t opt in by then may lose access to their allocation.

Canopy Network has confirmed a $CNPY token airdrop through a points-based rewards program. Points earned through platform activity — including retroactive rewards for early participation, testnet interactions, and quests — will convert to $CNPY allocations at a future date.
Check for New Challenges and Beta Invites
Claim Sepolia Testnet ETH
Claim Your CT Tokens
Claim Your CZR
Claim Your Seat on MINDS.GAMES
Claim Your XDP
Click “Claim” and confirm the transaction. The claim only counts once it confirms on-chain, so check the explorer if the page doesn’t update.
Click “Connect Wallet” and approve the connection in MetaMask, Rabby or another Ethereum wallet. The page shows your CZR allocation once the wallet is connected.
Click “Connect Wallet” and approve the connection with an EVM wallet.
Click the claim button and confirm the transaction in your wallet before the window closes on October 5, 2026.
Complete Missions and Zealy Quests
Complete Quests and Featured Weekly Tasks
Complete Quests on Galxe, Zealy and TaskOn
Complete the education quiz on the Tasks page for 150 points. You need a passing score, and the quiz refreshes every week.
Complete the posting challenge by sharing a post about Raycash with your followers. Adding your referral link to the post lets any sign-ups from it count toward your referral points.
Complete the verification in the app to secure your 500 PX1. The tokens go to the wallet you verified with at TGE, so keep access to it.
Complete Your Profile and Connect X
Confirm your claim

Connect an EVM wallet from your dashboard. This earns 100 points and is required to appear on any leaderboard or receive an allowlist place. The only wallet action is a free ownership signature, with no gas, approvals or token allowances.

Connect the wallet you used for Concrete vaults or the Points dashboard. MetaMask and other self-custody EVM wallets work. The wallet must be one you own and control, and eligibility can’t be moved to a different address.
Connect Your Eligible Wallet
Connect Your Social Accounts
Connect Your Wallet to ACI

Copy your link from the Rewards & referrals section and send it to people who plan to use Synthra. Sign-ups alone earn nothing; you only receive referral points once invitees complete qualifying activity.
Copy your personal referral link from the dashboard and send it to friends who might use a private stablecoin account. Each person who signs up through your link adds RP to your total.

Copy your personal referral link from the dashboard and share it. A referral only activates, and pays 250 points, once the new user signs up, connects a wallet and links or creates a Mind. Referees who also connect X count for more.
Create or Import a Wallet
Create or Link a Mind on HelloMinds
Create Your Profile on the TastyCo App
CZR/USDT spot trading opens on CZR Exchange on October 1. CZR deposits and withdrawals on the exchange stay paused until October 11 at 1:00 PM Singapore time, while trading itself remains open.

DeepBook’s main live campaign is the waitlist for its new trading app. Access opens in waves, and referring other traders moves you up the queue for earlier entry. Joining early and building referrals may position you for future rewards, though DeepBook has not confirmed a waitlist allocation.

Deposit any of the supported stablecoins into your Synthra account. If you need USDC, you can buy it on Bybit . Stablecoins sitting on another network can be moved or swapped with the widget below before you deposit. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab
Deposit Funds
Deposit Supported Coins

Deposit USDC, USDT, BTC, or another supported asset into your Arcus account. You can buy these on Bybit , then move them to Robinhood Chain with the bridge widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab
Deposit XRP Into the Doppler Vault for Future Seasons
Doppler’s docs list the XDP contract on Base as 0x07b3D902783c3C12b077508c3B5c00113d1291D0. Add it to your wallet as a custom token, and ignore any other token calling itself XDP.
Download PowerX OneWallet

dYdX Labs has confirmed that Arcus will launch its own token, separate from DYDX, with an allocation reserved for people who traded, staked, or validated on dYdX. Arcus Points are the main way to farm it now, although the team has not said how points will convert to tokens.

Each verified friend who joins earns you +75 points. Your first five referrals count instantly; after that, invitees must verify Discord and X and reach 100 points before the bonus lands. Multi-accounting gets filtered out on review.
Earn Discord Roles and Join Events

Entropy has no token and no announced airdrop. Its site, docs, and X account make no mention of a token, points program, season, or quest system. Any retroactive reward for early traders is speculation, based on how other Hyperliquid ecosystem projects have treated pre-token activity.

Ethena runs a seasonal rewards program where users earn points called “Sats” for holding and deploying USDe, staking ENA, and using partner protocols. Each season ends with a proportional ENA distribution based on the Sats you accumulated. Five seasons have already paid out, and Season 6 is currently live.

Every $1M in perps volume earns you an invite code, and volume from traders you referred counts toward that total. Find your codes under Rewards > Referrals. Anyone who signs up with your code becomes your referral, and their trading adds to your referral points bonus.
Fables has not confirmed an airdrop. Its documentation says points are intended to count toward a possible future token distribution, subject to separate final terms.
Find an Active Market
Find the Base Address You Registered
Follow PowerX on X
Follow PowerX One on X and engage with the pinned post as the bot instructs.
Follow Raycash on X
Follow the Announcement Channel
Follow the PowerX announcement channel on Telegram, where the team posts project updates.
Fund Your Wallet With USDC on Base
Get ETH for the Claim Fee
Get the Official XDP Contract Address

Go to Arcus and connect your wallet or sign up with Google. Signing up through our link gives you 5% off trading fees. Arcus is not available in the US, Canada, the UK, and other restricted jurisdictions.
Go to MINDS.GAMES , enter your email, accept the campaign rules and click “Claim Your Seat.” Login works through a one-hour email link, so there is no password to set.
Go to the “wallet” tab and swap Sepolia ETH for $ACI. Verify the missions you plan to complete first, then swap enough ACI to cover staking and any mission requirements.

Go to the Concrete Foundation claim page . Concrete has warned about fake claim sites, so only use concretefoundation.xyz or links from Concrete’s official X and Discord. Our airdrop safety guide covers what to check first.

Go to the CZR claim page on the airdrop.czrex.com domain. Genesis and Quest participants both claim here. Ignore claim links sent through DMs, comments or search ads, and read our airdrop safety guide if you are unsure about a site.
Go to the Kash app , connect your X account, and confirm a recovery email. Use the account you post from, since trades run through replies. Completing your profile earns your first 50 XP.
Go to the Raycash waitlist and sign up with your email address.
Go to the Synthra app .

HertzFlow has confirmed both a token generation event and an airdrop. Official documentation describes Merits, the protocol’s reward points, as your weight in that airdrop: at TGE they convert into an allocation and reset to zero. Season 1 runs entirely through the Genesis Vault, a capped pre-deposit event where every Merit comes from supplying liquidity. Neither the allocation size nor a TGE date has been published.
Hold an Eligible Robinhood NFT (Optional)
Hold Positions to Resolution and Claim Winnings

Hotstuff is closing perpetual markets on September 25, 2026 at 14:30 UTC and ending spot trading and app withdrawals on October 1, 2026 at 03:59 UTC (September 30, 11:59 PM ET). The team is shutting down current trading as it works toward an acquisition of Hotstuff Labs, with plans to relaunch its products under the acquiring company’s brand.
Huma Finance has opened the Season 4 eligibility checker. Visit the eligibility checker to connect your wallet and confirm whether you qualify. Full distribution details haven’t been released yet.

If you missed the Genesis Airdrop, deposit XRP from your XRPL wallet into the Doppler XRP Vault . Doppler has confirmed future DP seasons without sharing dates or rules, so a deposit now only positions you early. Our airdrop farming guide covers how to spread activity across programs like this.

If you own an eligible Robinhood NFT, keep it in your connected wallet. The 1.5x multiplier applies only while the NFT stays there, and the team has not published the list of qualifying collections yet.
If you prefer not to post, open a market in the Kash app , choose YES or NO, set your size, and confirm.

Import the official CT contract so the balance shows up: 0x0A092E544DA31150b439a1aAA1A3a2214a867F46 . The same address is used on Ethereum and BNB Chain. Ignore any other “CT” token that appears in your wallet.
Import the Registered Base Address Into Your Wallet
Invite Friends for Extra PX1
Invite Qualified Referrals
Join the Creator Program
Join the PowerX Telegram Community
Join the PowerX Telegram group from the bot’s task list.
Join the Raycash Telegram Community
Join the Raycash Telegram through the challenge card to claim the last starter reward. The team posts releases there and answers questions from users.
Join the Raycash Waitlist

Kash creates a self-custody Privy wallet for you on sign-up, with no seed phrase to manage. Top it up by connecting an existing wallet, depositing crypto directly, or using a card or Apple Pay. You can buy USDC on Bybit , and if your funds sit on another chain, the widget below can bridge or swap them to Base. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

Kash’s documentation reserves 25% of the total KASH supply for community incentives, paid out for trading accuracy, market creation, liquidity provision, and referrals. A TGE date and the exact token distribution method have not been announced, so XP and leaderboard activity are the best available signals for a future allocation.

Keep a small amount of ETH on Base to cover the claim transaction and to move or trade XDP afterwards. You can buy ETH on Bybit and withdraw it directly to Base, or send ETH from another chain to Base with the bridge widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab
Keep Collateral on the Exchange
Keep the USDC in the wallet, export the key to a wallet like Phantom , or cash out and swap through the built-in MoonPay and Jupiter integrations. Both run their own terms and KYC checks.
Keep your Grass node running

Limitless has opened its Season 3 airdrop claim, with 3% of the total $LMTS supply set aside to reward traders on the platform. Eligible users can connect their wallet at the claim portal to check their allocation and claim their tokens.
Log in to the Grass Dashboard

Make sure the Base address is loaded in an EVM wallet you control, such as MetaMask or Rabby. Submitted addresses cannot be changed, so if you registered an address you can no longer access, the allocation cannot be recovered.
Markets appear in your feed from the Kash account on X, creator accounts, and partner accounts. Pick ones where you have an actual read on the outcome.

MindGames has not announced a token or a token airdrop. The live reward is a spot on a 600-place NFT allowlist, earned through a pre-season points leaderboard. Points have no monetary value and cannot be transferred.
Monster NFT Reveal on October 14
Nado now supports xStocks for spot trading and as collateral. AAPLx, METAx, GOOGLx, TSLAx, and NVDAx are live on the platform and can be traded or used to back positions.

Nexus has not made an official airdrop announcement yet, but allocations can already be checked through the project’s explorer. Visit the Nexus explorer , enter your wallet address in the search bar, and view any allocation tied to it.
No Acepyr airdrop has been announced. The company’s terms are blunt: testnet $ACEPYR is a symbolic point system with no economic value, it cannot be bought, and it may never be worth anything.

Nodes keep earning points after the Season 2 snapshot. The Grass Desktop app and the Grass Android app earned more than the browser extension in Season 2. New users can create a Grass account through our referral link, which costs you nothing and pays us if you sign up. Our airdrop farming guide covers running several passive setups at once.

Nowa Farming is the opening phase of Nowa’s Community Development Program, which runs across Devnet (live now), Testnet, and Mainnet. Participants earn NOWA tokens directly rather than points, and farmed NOWA converts to TGE allocation on a straight 1:1 basis.
Omega has not confirmed an airdrop or a TGE date for a main token. What exists today is pOmega, the official testing token that replaced the earlier PRE token.
On the staking page, stake your ACI tokens. The mission board stays locked until you stake, so this step is required before you can start earning toward your allocation.

Once the tasks above are done, the bot unlocks the download link. Android users install the app from Google Play. iPhone users join the beta through Apple TestFlight, so install the TestFlight app first.
Only calls of $10 or more held until the market resolves count toward XP, volume, streaks, and accuracy. Claim winnings from your balance once a market settles.

Open HelloMinds through the link in your dashboard and create your AI agent. If you already have a Mind, copy the three details from its HelloMinds profile into the dashboard to claim the one-time 100-point bonus. Have three conversations with your Mind to unlock $5 in HelloMinds credits These credits work on the platform only and are not cash or a token
Open the ACI testnet , connect MetaMask, and switch the network to Sepolia. Approve the connection request to link your wallet.
Open the Allocation tab. The Rewards Checker shows your USDC amount for Epochs 1 to 19.
Open the app and create a new wallet, or import one you already use. If you create a new one, write the recovery phrase down offline. It’s generated on your phone and PowerX has no way to restore it.

Open the Concrete app if you plan to hold. Staking CT can reduce protocol fees on your own vault activity, and locking CT gives voting power over strategy approvals, collateral rules, and fee frameworks. Governance is rolling out in stages.
Open the Grass Dashboard and sign in with the account you farmed Season 2 on. It’s the only place Grass runs checks and claims.
Open the newsletter challenge on your dashboard and subscribe to In confidence, the Raycash newsletter for product news and insights. This adds another 100 RP.
Open the Official CZR Claim Page
Open the Points Dashboard to see your weekly Season 1 points and your Season 0 leaderboard rank. New points land every Wednesday at 3PM EST.
Open the PowerX Airdrop Bot
Open the PowerX Airdrop Bot on Telegram and tap Start. The bot lists your tasks and tracks which ones you’ve finished.

Open the spot market and trade any of the 95+ stock tokens. Spot trades carry no fees, and stock tokens currently earn boosted points. Trading outside regular US market hours adds a further boost. If you use Robinhood Wallet, swaps routed through Arcus also qualify for boosted spot points.

Open the Tasks page and complete the one-time social tasks: Connect your X account Connect Telegram through the TastyCo bot (+150 points) Join the TastyCo Discord server (+100 points) Follow TastyCo on Instagram (+100 points)

Open the XDP Airdrop portal, connect your registered Base address and sign the claim transaction. Each address claims its full allocation in one transaction. The claim closes on November 28, 2026, at 12:00 UTC. Other live distributions are listed on our claims page .
Pass the Weekly Education Quiz
Paste your wallet address into the eligibility checker and click “Check.” Use the Ethereum wallet you connected during the Genesis campaign or the Quest program.
Perps now require an invite code from an existing Arcus trader. Connect your wallet on Arcus and enter the code when prompted. Traders who already had access don’t need one.
Place a Trade From Your Feed
Post About Raycash on X
Post Community Content on X

PowerX OneWallet is running a community airdrop that pays 500 PX1 to every participant who completes the social tasks in the PowerX Airdrop Bot and verifies in the app. No purchase or deposit is needed. The product already exists, and finishing the tasks is also what unlocks the app download link.
Provide In-Range Liquidity
Publish a post about TastyCo on X and submit it through the Community content task. It pays 150 points and becomes available again every 3 days.

Raycash has not announced a token, a ticker, or an airdrop. Raycash Points are the only reward system so far, and the team has not said whether RP will convert into anything. That makes this a speculative airdrop built on early activity.

Reels runs a welcome offer for new players: a 275% match up to 2,000 USDT plus 50 free spins. The bonus is credited automatically once a qualifying deposit is made with the promo code applied before checkout. A separate welcome package of up to $5,000 is listed for VIP players, though Reels does not publish the criteria for VIP status.
Refer Traders Who Stay Active
REP has not announced a token or an airdrop. What exists is a live points system where achievements and connections award REP points that feed a public ranking.

Reply to or quote-post the market with your side and amount, tagging the account that launched it: Kash market : tag @kash_bot_trades, for example “@kash_bot_trades YES 50” Creator market : tag that creator’s account Partner market : tag the partner’s handle
Retained deposits count toward Season 1 points. Leaving collateral on Arcus between trades scores better than depositing and withdrawing each session.
Return to the dashboard regularly, since new challenges appear as the team adds them. Beta access rolls out in waves, so watch your inbox and the Raycash X account for your invite.

Review the amount and confirm. The fees come out of your allocation, so there’s nothing to deposit. When Solana fees spike, Grass suggests waiting a few days before claiming. Full rules are in the Grass Rewards Program Terms .
Satsuma’s airdrop checker is now live ahead of the SUMA TGE on June 4, 2026, with 3,000,000 SUMA allocated to early supporters, liquidity providers, and community members.
Set up the wallet built into the dashboard and secure it with a passkey or email code. It’s non-custodial: Grass can’t move your funds and you can export the key at any time.
Share Your Invite Codes
Share your referral link from the app. A referral counts once your friend trades $50 to resolution, and your weekly pool bonus mirrors the rank your referee finishes at.
Share your referral link from the PowerX Airdrop Bot to earn additional PX1 on top of the 500 PX1 base reward. This step is optional.
Share your TastyCo referral link from the app. Each qualified referral earns 200 points, with milestone bonuses when you reach 3, 5, 10 and 20 referrals.
Sign Up on Arcus
Sign Up on the Kash App
Stake ACI to Unlock Missions
Stake or Lock CT in the Concrete App

StarkNet airdropped 700 million STRK to various early StarkNet and Ethereum users in the form of provisions. Starknet users, developers and community contributors, StarkEx users, Ethereum protocol contributors and stakers and developers of select non-crypto open-source projects received the airdrop.
Stay active in Discord to earn the Creator, OG or Ambassador roles, which carry extra rewards. Join AMAs and contests as they come up, and apply to the Ambassador program if you post regularly.
Submit your details through the Entropy Partners application form . The team reviews each application manually and onboards accepted partners in batches.
Subscribe to the In Confidence Newsletter
Swap ETH for ACI Test Tokens
Swap tokens, including cross-chain routes, or open perpetual positions. Volume earns from the 15% trading share up to $100,000 per day, and anything above that cap adds no points.

Synthra has confirmed a community airdrop of $SYN for top participants, ranked by combined mainnet Synthra Points, testnet points and Synthra OG status. The team plans to distribute tokens in the days after the $SYN launch but has not published the allocation size or an exact claim date.

TastyCo has confirmed a $100,000 $TASTY airdrop campaign, run through a pre-TGE points system. The tokenomics reserve 5% of supply for airdrops and another 15% for community quests and rewards paid out over 36 months.

The $O token airdrop is confirmed for Season 1 participants. Allocation is determined by a nonlinear formula that weighs multiple signals rather than any single metric, specifically designed to reward genuine traders over farmers gaming one dimension of the system.

The $VOICE token and its token generation event are confirmed, with the TGE targeted for Q4 2026. VOICE ties $VOICE distribution to activity: CLOUT earned in Social Camp hard-syncs to your profile, and the tiers list a base $VOICE airdrop allocation, whitelist access, NFT drops, and early access at the higher levels.

The airdrop is confirmed in TBook’s tokenomics, which reserves 7.5% of the fixed 10 billion $BOOK supply, or 750 million tokens. Eligibility weights WISE score and verifiable contribution history over wallet count, so one well-built profile beats a spread of empty addresses.

The airdrop is confirmed, retroactive, and live. A fixed pool of 280 million $GRVT goes to traders who earned points during Genesis Season 1 (100 million tokens) and Season 2 (180 million tokens). Both seasons have closed and point totals are final. Registration closed on July 27, 2026 (00:00 UTC): users who registered and accepted the terms in time can now check and claim their allocation, while unregistered allocations are forfeited with no exceptions. What remains is checking your amount and claiming your tranches on schedule.

The airdrop is confirmed. Hayes has stated a large $FLOP distribution is planned for Q4 2026, ahead of the genesis block in Q1 2027, though eligibility rules and snapshot dates are unpublished. His 19 August essay put roughly 20% of supply with testnet participants, released across ten years.

The ARX token generation event took place on June 22, 2026, on Solana. Tokens reached the community through Arcium’s Retroactive Token Grant (RTG) system, which rewards verified contributors rather than running an open points farm. Allocations went live before trading opened, and the eligibility checker is now active.

The claim is an Ethereum transaction, so you need a small amount of ETH on Ethereum mainnet for gas. You can buy ETH on Bybit , or bridge and swap funds from another chain to Ethereum with the widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

The claim is an on-chain transaction, so keep a small amount of ETH in the wallet. You can buy ETH on Bybit , or move ETH over from another chain with the bridge widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

The Collector Crypt airdrop is confirmed and recurring. The team runs a quarterly rewards program that distributes $CARDS to active users, and $CARDS holders receive separate monthly airdrops on top of that. The most recent quarterly distribution went live on June 14, 2026, releasing 15 million $CARDS.

The Concrete (CT) airdrop is confirmed and claimable. CT reached its TGE on September 30, 2026, and eligible wallets can now claim through the official Concrete Foundation site. Only addresses on the CT Eligibility List can claim, and each allocation is locked to the wallet it was assigned to.

The CZR Genesis Airdrop ran from September 21 to 30, 2026, and rewarded users who completed account, wallet and social tasks with campaign coins. Midway through, the team doubled the Genesis pool from 5 million to 10 million CZR and doubled coins on qualifying tasks. Users who earned points in the earlier CZR Quest program also receive CZR, tracked separately from the Genesis pool.
The Day 1 airdrop is confirmed and its snapshots have closed, claim will run 30 days from TGE, after which anything unclaimed is burned. A second round exists with no published rules.

The Grass Season 2 airdrop, officially called Stage 2, is a live USDC claim. It pays everyone who shared bandwidth with Grass between October 14, 2024 and June 8, 2026. The claim closes on January 22, 2027.

The Infinex airdrop is confirmed and live. The INX token launched at its TGE on January 30, 2026, at 19:00 UTC, with the Patron NFT snapshot taken earlier that day at 07:00 UTC. INX is now trading on exchanges including Binance Alpha, KuCoin, and MEXC, and Coinbase has added it to its listing roadmap.

The Jupiter airdrop is confirmed and has run in phases since January 2024. Jupuary 2026 was the third and final annual distribution, and its claim window has now closed. Unclaimed allocations went back to the DAO treasury. What continues is Active Staking Rewards (ASR), a quarterly pool paid to JUP stakers who vote on DAO proposals, and the Q2 2026 round is open for claims now.

The Kryvora Network airdrop is confirmed and runs on points. Testers earn PTS through onchain, social, daily, and node tasks, and the team has published a fixed conversion of 100 PTS to 1 $KRV. The TGE date has not been announced.

The Memebook airdrop is confirmed in principle: the project states that XP earned in the app today converts into $MBK utility at TGE. The allocation size and the XP-to-token rate have not been announced, so the sensible goal right now is banking XP rather than modelling a payout.

The Pharos $PROS airdrop claim is now live! Eligible participants have 180 days, from April 28 to October 25, 2026, to claim their allocations before unclaimed amounts are returned to the Pharos Foundation and the claim portal closes. Eligibility includes Testnet Participants, “Stake Before the Stake” Contributors, Pharos Discord Role Holders, and OKX Wallet Campaign Users. If participants qualify under multiple categories, their claims will be automatically consolidated into a single submission.

The Season 1 airdrop is confirmed and distributes $125,000 worth of $MNTD to eligible players based on verified platform activity. Casino and sportsbook play earns XP, and your final leaderboard position at the snapshot decides your share.

The SoSoValue airdrop is confirmed and running, with SOSO already live and trading. The current campaign rewards three kinds of activity: earning EXP through platform tasks (Season 3 is now live), staking SSI index tokens, and trading on SoDEX. Each feeds a points system that converts into SOSO. SoDEX follows the same perp-DEX airdrop model that drove earlier campaigns like Hyperliquid .

The Sweep airdrop is a confirmed campaign with 27% of the total supply, roughly 270 million SWEEP, reserved for participants. You collect XP by completing activities across the ecosystem, and your final allocation depends on the XP you hold when the campaign closes. The XP to SWEEP conversion rate and the TGE date have not been announced; both arrive after the campaign ends.

The TREAD token is confirmed. The Tread Foundation has announced TREAD, a token used within the tread.fi ecosystem, and has tied the points seasons to it: Season 2 begins only once more token utility is built around TREAD.

The XDP Airdrop portal is now open for claims. Registration closed on July 30, 2026. Check your saved screenshot or wallet history from July for the Base address you submitted, because only that address can claim.

The Yakkamon airdrop is confirmed and NFT focused. The top 5,000 trainers on the Season 0 points leaderboard receive Monster NFTs when early access launches: ranks 1 to 1,000 get Legendary Monster NFTs and ranks 1,001 to 5,000 get Rare Monster NFTs. Rank depends on points only, never on sign-up order.
Track Your Points
Trade CZR on CZR Exchange
Trade Directly in the App
Trade Spot and Perps
Trade Stock Tokens on Spot
Unlock Perps With an Invite Code
Use the challenge card to follow @raycashxyz on X. The account posts product updates and beta announcements.

Vangrid has not confirmed an airdrop. A token is planned for later in 2026, but no allocation, snapshot, or eligibility rule has been published, which makes this a potential future airdrop rather than a scheduled one.
Verify and Claim Your PX1

Vibe Vibe says 5% of its token supply is set aside for testnet participants. Traders with strong PnL, token creators, and active users are the groups named as eligible. The allocation is discretionary: the team can exclude sybil and wash-trading wallets, and testnet points or leaderboard positions do not guarantee a reward.
Visit the Official CT Claim Page
Visit the Synthra App
Visit the TastyCo app , connect any EVM wallet, and finish registration. This step is mandatory: points earned on Galxe, Zealy or TaskOn only count if you have a TastyCo profile.

Visit the Time Capsule page , pick an open capsule, and submit your vote before it seals. VOICE will roll out capsules on different timelines and announce each one separately. Some open after a week, others after a month, and some stay sealed much longer, so check back for new capsules as they are announced.
Vote on an Open Capsule
Wait for the October 11 Unlock

Wick has not confirmed an airdrop, and no allocation, points system, or TGE date has been announced. The only official signal is the September 7, 2026 waitlist launch post, which says early users will be recognized.
